affected_system: land-use planning, public investment, regeneration, and community-benefit system
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for neighborhood development and displacement pressure
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for neighborhood development and displacement pressure
pair scenario-conditioned parcel and housing-market forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Parcels, zoning, ownership, development, business, housing, public assets, and population use dated versions.
Scenario capacity and market response are not treated as approved projects or inevitable change.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for neighborhood development and displacement pressure.

constraints.description: The land use, regeneration, and neighborhood change forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: planning director and neighborhood regeneration commissioner
decision_question: What range of land use, prices, development, tenure, and business change follows each policy scenario?
family_title: Land use, regeneration, and neighborhood change

independence_key.binding_constraint: The land use, regeneration, and neighborhood change forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for neighborhood development and displacement pressure passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.primary_outcome: residents and businesses exposed to modeled involuntary displacement pressure

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting neighborhood development and displacement pressure, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: residents and businesses exposed to modeled involuntary displacement pressure
distributional gap in residents and businesses exposed to modeled involuntary displacement pressure
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not present market scenarios as inevitable development or individual displacement predictions.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for neighborhood development and displacement pressure passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast development, affordability, and displacement pressure
transportability_risks: Planning law, property rights, finance, markets, institutions, and community priorities differ.
